description: The union of a nonempty family of Dedekind cuts bounded above by a cut is itself a cut and is their least upper bound under inclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cut_union_lub (F : Set Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.Cut) (hne : F.Nonempty)
  (hb : ∃ U, ∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.IsCut (⋃ A ∈ F, ↑A) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ⋃ B ∈ F, ↑B) ∧ ∀ (U : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.Cut), (∀ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U) → ⋃ A ∈ F, ↑A ⊆ ↑U
